name: Texture Intake
description: Turn hand-painted or image-generated art into a game-ready tileable texture family: offset-wrap seamless tiling, an optional luma-derived normal map (off by default — hand-painted art carries its own light), and an updated theme data asset slot.

image.label: Source image
image.description: The generated texture art (PNG). Any 8-bit PNG works: RGB, RGBA, grayscale, or palette.

name.label: Output name
name.description: Texture id below assets/textures; folders are allowed (theme folders like drowned-a/mossy-brick are the convention). The .png suffix is added automatically.

slot.label: Theme slot
slot.description: Which theme role this texture fills. With a theme id set, the theme data asset's slot is created/updated; "none" skips theme wiring.

theme.label: Theme id
theme.description: Optional theme data-asset id. When set (and slot is not "none"), themes/<id>.json is created or updated in place: this slot gets { map, uvScale }, other slots are preserved.

metresPerTile.label: Metres per tile
metresPerTile.description: World size one texture tile covers, recorded in the theme slot as uvScale [m, m] (metres per tile, NOT a repeat count).

makeSeamless.label: Make seamless
makeSeamless.description: Make the texture tile seamlessly: offset-wrap by half the image size and cross-blend a feathered band (~12% of size) across the wrap seams. Image-gen output is never seamless — leave this on.

normalFromLuma.label: Normal from luma
normalFromLuma.description: Derive a tangent-space normal map (OpenGL +Y) from luminance via Sobel gradients and write <name>-normal.png alongside. OFF by default: this art direction is HAND-PAINTED, so the texture already carries its own light and form, and a luma-derived normal re-lights that painted detail a second time (painted shadows read as dents). Turn it on only for a surface whose relief is genuinely geometric rather than painted.

normalStrength.label: Normal strength
normalStrength.description: Normal map intensity. 1 is deliberately light — the stylized look wants suggestion, not geology.

previewTiling.label: Preview tiling
previewTiling.description: Return a 3x3 tiled preview (384px) so any remaining seams are instantly visible in the dialog.
